upcoming_events.title: 30A 10K Thanksgiving Day Races
upcoming_events.description: Thanksgiving-morning 10K, 5K and 1-mile fun run through Rosemary Beach — 10K starts 7:30 AM, 1-mile 7:35 AM, 5K 9:30 AM · packet pickup Wed Nov 25 at The Big Chill, no race-day pickup · advance registration only, closes Nov 24 · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Turn On The Town
upcoming_events.description: Seaside's holiday season opens Saturday Nov 28: the parade steps off from Seagrove Plaza at 3 PM and winds to Central Square, followed by a live performance from Emerald Coast Theatre Company at Krier Plaza and the town tree lighting in the Amphitheater around 5 PM, with a visit from Santa. Free and open to all · 5-min walk or drive.

upcoming_events.title: Seaside Holiday Market
upcoming_events.description: Saturday 9 AM–4 PM and Sunday 10 AM–4 PM in Central Square · local makers and gift vendors kick off the holiday season · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: New Year's Eve in Seaside
upcoming_events.description: Central Square's family celebration runs 4–9 PM with arts and crafts and a photo spot at the Post Office, live music from 5:30 PM, and fireworks at 9 PM · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Baytowne Wharf New Year's Eve Countdown
upcoming_events.description: The Village of Baytowne Wharf rings in 2027 with live music on the Events Plaza Stage from 6 PM, a family fireworks show at 8 PM, a drone show over the lagoon, and a midnight fireworks finale · 35-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: 30A Songwriters Festival
upcoming_events.description: 18th annual · MLK weekend · songwriters across 30A's intimate listening rooms in Seaside, Rosemary, Alys, WaterColor, Grayton and more, with headliners including St. Paul & The Broken Bones and Gillian Welch & David Rawlings · benefits the Cultural Arts Alliance · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Sounds of Seaside Concert Series
upcoming_events.description: Through Nov 25 · Wed 4–6 PM · Free Wednesday-evening concerts on the Seaside Amphitheater lawn, 4–6 PM, closing out the fall season with Roman Street on Nov 18 and Boukou Groove on Nov 25 · free and open to all ages · bring blankets and chairs, snacks and drinks welcome · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Seaside Farmers Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sat 9–1 · Saturdays year-round, 9 AM–1 PM at the Seaside Amphitheater, with a second Tuesday market added each June and July · local growers, artisan cheeses and breads, craft chefs, and live acoustic music · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: 30A Farmers' Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sun 9–1 · About 30 vendors on Barrett Square every Sunday, 9 AM–1 PM — local produce and micro-greens, Gulf seafood off the boat, artisan breads and sweets, grass-fed beef, tupelo honey · pet-friendly · a great Sunday-morning outing · 15-min drive east

copy.instagram:
Golden Sun is open Wed Dec 30 – Fri Jan 1, three nights to close out the year.

Seaside's Central Square party runs 4–9 PM on the 31st — live music from 5:30, fireworks at 9, five minutes by car.

Come home to a full kitchen and a fire in the living room.

Book direct, link in bio.
copy.facebook: Golden Sun has Wed Dec 30 – Fri Jan 1 open, three nights that line up with New Year's Eve in Seaside: crafts and a photo spot at the Post Office from 4 PM, live music from 5:30, fireworks at 9, all five minutes away by car. Then back to the cottage for a fire and a quiet kitchen to make breakfast in on New Year's Day — book direct at book.sunandmoon30a.com.

copy.instagram:
Both cottages are open Thu Dec 24 – Sat 26, three nights over Christmas.

Six bedrooms, four baths, sixteen people — side by side on the same quiet lane in Seagrove.

One address, so nobody is driving across town to open presents.

Save the dates, link in bio.
copy.facebook: Golden Sun and Blue Moon are both open Thu Dec 24 – Sat 26 — six bedrooms, four baths and room for sixteen, side by side on the same quiet lane in Seagrove, so the whole family wakes up at one address on Christmas morning. Live availability and real prices at book.sunandmoon30a.com.
